objects.description: flat robot base plate (acrylic or plastic) with mounting holes
small yellow DC gear motor (TT motor) with two solder tabs
small bracket that holds a DC motor against the chassis
rubber wheel that press-fits on the motor shaft
small free-spinning ball or swivel caster at the front of the chassis
small blue SG90 micro servo with a three-wire cable (brown, red, orange)
bracket or cut-out that holds the servo body
white plastic arm that slides onto the servo's splined output shaft
small M3 or self-tapping screw
M3 nut matching the screws
short hex spacer that lifts a board above the chassis
small Phillips screwdriver
Arduino Uno-style microcontroller board
small motor driver board (L298N or similar) with screw terminals
HC-SR04 distance sensor with two round transducers ('eyes') and four pins
bracket that holds the ultrasonic sensor at the front
colored jumper wire with pin connectors
the servo's three-wire cable ending in a 3-pin connector
battery holder (4xAA) with red and black leads
AA batteries
small slide or rocker power switch
small plastic cable tie

actions.label_es: montar el soporte del motor en el chasis
actions.visual_cue: a small bracket is placed against the chassis edge and held in place over its holes

actions.label_es: montar el motor en su soporte
actions.visual_cue: the yellow gear motor is pressed against the bracket with its shaft pointing outward
a screwdriver turns long screws through the bracket and the motor body

actions.label_es: poner la rueda en el eje del motor
actions.visual_cue: a rubber wheel is pushed onto the motor's shaft until flush
a small ball caster is held under the front of the chassis and screwed in

actions.label_es: insertar el servo en su soporte
actions.visual_cue: the blue servo body slides into its bracket with the shaft facing up
the servo sits in its bracket with the output shaft pointing down or into the chassis
a screwdriver drives two small screws through the servo's mounting ears into the bracket
a white plastic arm is pressed onto the servo's splined shaft
a tiny screw is driven through the center of the servo arm into the shaft
the sensor with two round 'eyes' is placed in its front mount, eyes facing forward
short hex spacers are screwed into the chassis where the board will sit
the blue microcontroller board is laid on the spacers and screwed down
a small red or blue board with a heatsink and screw terminals is screwed to the chassis

actions.label_es: conectar los cables del motor al driver
actions.visual_cue: the motor's two wires are inserted into the driver's screw terminals and tightened

actions.label_es: conectar el cable del servo a la placa
actions.visual_cue: the servo's 3-pin connector is pushed onto the board's pins, brown wire on GND

actions.label_es: conectar el cable del servo invertido
actions.visual_cue: the servo connector is plugged in with the orange signal wire on the GND side (colors reversed)

actions.label_es: conectar el sensor a la placa
actions.visual_cue: four jumper wires run from the sensor's pins to the board's header

actions.label_es: conectar el driver a la placa
actions.visual_cue: jumper wires run from the driver's input pins to the board's digital pins
the black battery holder is placed under or on the chassis and held with screws or tape
AA batteries are pressed into the holder one by one
a battery sits in the holder with its flat (negative) end against the spring's opposite side, polarity reversed
the battery holder's red and black leads are connected to the switch / driver power terminals
loose wires are bundled against the chassis with a small cable tie
a finger flips the power switch and an LED on the board lights up
